author: codex-root

findings.summary: QuickSearch registers a global shortcut listener that is unreachable in the current mount path.
findings.consequence: The component carries a second shortcut implementation that does no useful work in the current app and can drift from the guarded shell shortcut policy for modifiers, contenteditable targets, and open dialogs.
findings.evidence: The owned mount callback registers `onGlobalKeydown` on line 383. Current source search found QuickSearch is mounted only by `app/components/global/SiteShell.vue` as `<LazyQuickSearch v-if="quickSearchOpen" initially-open />`; SiteShell opens it before mount. With `initiallyOpen`, `isOpen` is already true when the listener is installed, so `onGlobalKeydown` returns before calling `open()`. The actual production shortcut is already handled by SiteShell via `isProductionShortcutGuarded`.
findings.recommendation: Delete the QuickSearch-owned global keydown registration and its private `onGlobalKeydown`/standalone `open` path once the unused internal trigger branch is removed, keeping shortcut ownership in `SiteShell.vue`. If standalone mounting is still required, reuse the same `isProductionShortcutGuarded` policy instead of this local listener.
